lines.text: Hi, this is Dana Kim from Brightline Consulting. I'd like to reserve twenty rooms for our sales conference next month.
Certainly. Which dates do you need?
May twelfth through the fifteenth. Our first session starts early on the thirteenth, so everyone has to arrive the night before.
Let me check. Unfortunately, we're fully booked on the twelfth. There's a medical convention in town that week.
Oh, no. That's the night we need most.
Why don't you try the Parkside Inn? It's our sister hotel, just two blocks away, and it still has rooms that night.
That sounds good. Could you e-mail me their phone number?
Sure. I'll send it to you right after this call.
Hi, I need two hundred posters for our gallery's opening night next Saturday. Can you have them ready by Thursday?
Sure. Would you like them printed on glossy paper or matte?
Glossy, please. The design file is on this USB drive.
Great. I'll print one sample copy first so you can check the colors.
The copier on the third floor jammed again this morning.
That's the third time this week.
I know. I'll ask the office manager about getting a new one.
Did you hear? Mina's team just signed another big contract.
They really deserve the sales award this year.
Ms. Lee from Fairway called. She wants to move our meeting again.
Let's ask her to confirm the new time by e-mail.
Ana, is everything ready for this afternoon's training workshop?
Almost. But we can't use Room 3. The projector there isn't working.
Hmm. What about the room across from the elevator? It's about the same size.
Good idea. I'll move the chairs and the handouts there now.
Raj, Kenji, thanks for coming. The client just moved our deadline up to this Friday.
This Friday? We haven't even recorded the voice-over yet.
I can record it tomorrow morning. The studio downstairs is free.
Great. Then, Raj, could you finish editing the video by Thursday?
I'll do my best, but I'll need Kenji's recording by noon tomorrow.
No problem. I'll send it to you as soon as I'm done.
Hello, Mr. Alvarez. This is Grace from Sunbridge Dental Clinic.
I'm calling about your appointment tomorrow at ten.
Unfortunately, Dr. Patel has to attend a conference, so she won't be in the office tomorrow morning.
Could you call us back to choose a new time? We have openings on Thursday afternoon.
Our number is 555-0148, and we're open until six today. Thank you.
Hi, this is Jason from the IT help desk. You sent us a message about your laptop?
Yes, thanks for calling back. The problem is, it keeps shutting down while I'm working, and I have a client presentation at three.
I see. I'm afraid we can't fix it today. We have a lot of repair requests, so we'll have to send it to the manufacturer.
Oh, no. All my slides are on that laptop.
Why don't you borrow one of our spare laptops for the afternoon? I can copy your files onto it.
That would be perfect. I'll bring my laptop down to your office right now.
Hi, I have a reservation for a compact car. The name is Laura Chen.
Welcome, Ms. Chen. Hmm, I'm afraid all of our compact cars are out right now. A flight was delayed, so several customers haven't returned theirs yet.
Oh, no. I have a meeting downtown at five, so I can't wait.
I understand. Why don't you take one of our larger models? There's no extra charge.
That's very kind of you. Here's my driver's license.
Thank you. Let me get the keys, and I'll walk you to the car.
Sora, Mark, have you seen the schedule for the office move?
Yes. The movers are coming on Saturday, so we have to pack our desks by Friday afternoon.
Friday afternoon? I'll be visiting clients all day on Friday.
Don't worry. I'll be here all week.
Really? That would be a huge help. I'll label my boxes before I leave on Thursday.
And Mark, could you return the projector to the storage room before you go?
Sure. I'll take care of it on Thursday.
Ben, have you signed up for one of the training workshops on Monday?
Not yet. I'm meeting a client in the morning, so it has to be in the afternoon.
How about Customer Service? I heard it's really good.
It sounds interesting, but it runs until five, and I have to leave at four-thirty on Mondays.
Then take the one right after lunch. I took it last year, and it really helped me organize my day.
OK, I'll sign up for that one. Could you send me the link to the registration page?
Sure. I'll forward it to you right now.
Good morning, everyone. Before we start, I have some news about our customer survey.
Last month, more than two thousand customers filled it out. That's twice as many as last year.
Most of them were happy with our delivery times, but many said our mobile app is hard to use.
So we've hired a design firm to improve it, and their team will visit us on Wednesday.
I'd like each team leader to meet with them and share your customers' comments.
Now, let's move on to this month's sales figures.
Welcome aboard the Riverside Boat Tour. My name is Paolo, and I'll be your guide this afternoon.
Our trip will take about ninety minutes, and we'll pass under six of the city's famous bridges.
Halfway through the tour, we'll stop at Lantern Island, where you can buy snacks and souvenirs.
Please keep your tickets with you. You'll need to show them to get back on the boat.
All right, we're about to leave, so please take your seats.
Kenji, Raj, the printer on our floor is broken again.
I can call the repair company right now.
Thanks. And Raj, could you print the handouts downstairs?
Sure. I'll go down after lunch.
